translations.text: [?: only "-g" survives of the first word, probably "Holy"] Father, you who dwell in the heavens, glorified in the joy of glory. May your name be hallowed by your works among the children of men; you are the saviour of men.
May your kingdom come far and wide, and your wise and steadfast will be raised up under the roof of the sky, and likewise on the broad earth.
Give us today glorious abundance, our bread, the everlasting bread, O helper of men, righteous Creator.
Do not let temptations press upon us too hard, but give us freedom, ruler of peoples, from every evil, forever and ever.
